beats_rule_based_baseline.requirement: AI net return after fees > rule-based baseline net return

accuracy_not_suspiciously_high.requirement: <= 75% total directional accuracy to reduce leakage risk

trade_accuracy_not_suspiciously_high.requirement: <= 85% trade directional accuracy to reduce leakage risk

time_slices_have_a_winner.requirement: >= 1 profitable chronological test slice when at least 2 slices are evaluated

regimes_not_all_losing.requirement: not 0 profitable regimes when at least 3 regimes are evaluated

demo_safety_gate.note: PASS only means usable for the demo/paper website. It is not real-money approval.
